name: Silithus: a ghost released in Twilight's Run reaches a Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies inside Twilight's Run (zone 3446, at the middle of its main cave (-6275.9,9.2,9.3)) releases at the nearest graveyard of Silithus (1377), graveyard 70 (-6432.26,-278.292,3.79411), instead of the default Westfall graveyard. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Silithus graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
